changelog: Finding streams no longer hangs for 100 seconds and then reports none: each public indexer is now searched on its own with a 20 second limit, so one unreachable indexer only loses its own results. Includes 1.4.13.5: a resumed movie no longer shows twice in Continue Watching, and library titles keep their TMDB, IMDb and TVDB ids. Requires Jellyfin 12.1 or later. This is a beta release.
description: Server-side intelligence engine for the Orca X TV app: personalization, recommendations, caching, and centralized administration.
